title: MotionPatch
description: Motion patch envelope (D-15, adjustable graph). Atomically mutates one or more component fields of an in-flight motion node. Requires motion.patch capability (ADR-057). Patches are applied at the next frame boundary.

motion_intent_id.description: The intent whose graph is being patched.

patch_id.description: This patch's own identifier for audit and replay.

kind.description: Discriminator. Always 'motion.patch'. Distinct from motion.intent (D-09, anti-pattern: do NOT inherit from motion.intent).

path.description: Dot-notation path to patchable field: 'duration_ms', 'easing', 'to.translateY'. Immutable fields (node_id, kind) rejected with MOTION_PATCH_PATH_IMMUTABLE.

value.description: New value to set at path. Type checked against the node's component schema.

node_id.description: Node within the intent's MotionGraph to patch. Unknown node_id rejected with MOTION_PATCH_NODE_NOT_FOUND.

patches.description: Ordered patch operations applied atomically. Either all succeed (next frame uses new values) or all are rejected.

preserve_velocity.description: For AccumulatorNodes (spring/drag): keep current velocity and position across the patch to maintain physical continuity (D-11).

tier_capability_check.description: If true, patch is rejected with TIER_CAPABILITY_EXCEEDED on Tier B (CSS @keyframes cannot patch mid-flight).
